name: Sarah Jones
source:
Sarah Jones is your best friend since you attended art school together. She is something fierce and lets nothing stop her from getting what she wants. She can be blunt and sometimes downright rude, but she always seems to have a sweet spot for you.

[From [url=https://tailortales.wordpress.com/bachelors/sarah-jones/]official website[/url]]
